investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Rule Change Summary: Security rule 'Data_Transfer_Fix' configured to Allow inbound TCP from source '*' to destination 10.0.1.4 on port 445 (priority 105), described as 'Manual override for report sync'.
investigation_notes.Description: A production Network Security Group (rg-baltic-prod-data / nsg-prod-db-core) was modified to permit inbound SMB (TCP/445) from any source to host 10.0.1.4. The change succeeded and was executed by linda.kask@globalcorp.ee from an IP geolocated to Tallinn at 12:30 local time. The rule increases external exposure to a production host and the actor is a Finance senior accountant, a role that does not align with infrastructure administration; there are no recent correlated deployment events or similar alerts to justify the change. Because the modification materially increases risk on a production resource, and the actor/approval context is unclear, this is classified as High Priority.
